messages:
Zoe: Heads up — I noticed a ~+$12k unexpected accelerator-related line on the March invoice labeled "reservation-offset adjustment" for multiple regions. Link to invoice: https://billing.example.com/invoices/INV-2026-03-17 :eyes:
Alex: Can you paste the raw line items or a screenshot? helps to see the SKU and reservation ids.
Zoe: Pasting the relevant CSV rows from billing export:```
invoice_id,project,sku,region,usage_start,usage_end,amount_usd,description,reservation_id
INV-2026-03-17,redwood-prod,Accelerator:TESLA-A100,us-west1,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,4200.00,reservation-offset,RES-42
INV-2026-03-17,redwood-prod,Accelerator:TESLA-A100,us-central1,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,3900.00,reservation-offset,RES-42
INV-2026-03-17,redwood-prod,Accelerator:TESLA-A100,us-west1,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,4100.00,usage-charge,RES-42
INV-2026-03-17,redwood-prod,Accelerator:TESLA-A100,us-west1,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,4300.00,reservation-offset,RES-87
```
Zoe: Note the same reservation_id (RES-42) appears across regions + there's an extra RES-87 for us-west1.
BillingBot: Automated note: invoice INV-2026-03-17 generated 2026-03-17 02:12 UTC. Billing export finished. No auto-credits applied yet.
Maria: That looks like an allocation mismatch. Reservation discounts should only apply in the region where the reservation exists. If RES-42 is a regional reservation in us-west1, why is it offsetting us-central1?
Alex: Running a quick export from internal inventory to map reservation ids -> projects/regions:```
$ gcloud compute reservations describe RES-42 --format=json
region: us-west1
committed_slots: 48
labels: {"billing-account":"redwood-prod"}
```
Alex: RES-42 is us-west1 per provider API. So the provider exported offsets for us-central1 too — likely a billing-side bug or a linked-reservation mapping across projects.
Dave: I dug into our reserved capacity purchases. We have two commitments bought last year: one regional us-west1 (RES-42) and one multi-region promotion (RES-87). There is known overlap when a multi-region promo is applied then later converted to a regional reservation — double-counting can show up as "reservation-offset" then "usage-charge" on same resource.
SRE-Oncall: We also had a short-lived dedicated cluster for load testing in us-central1 that accidentally billed to the production billing account (wrong project tag) during Mar 12-15. That might have pulled usage into the same invoice and triggered offsets. I'm patching the tag rule now.
Maria: Can someone open a support ticket with the cloud provider? This looks like they applied RES-42 credits to us-central1 usage and also applied the multi-region promo RES-87 on top. Requesting a line-item level explanation and credit for the duplicate offsets.
Dave: Opening ticket now. I've included CSV above + internal reservation mapping. Draft message to provider: "We observe reservation discounts applied outside reservation region (RES-42) and overlapping with multi-region promotional reservation (RES-87), resulting in duplicate offset lines totaling ~$12,500. Please advise and propose invoice adjustment."
BillingBot: Support case created: CASE-2026-3872 with provider. Link: https://support.cloud.example/cases/CASE-2026-3872
Alex: In the meantime, estimate exposure if provider denies adjustment. Rough calc: duplicate offsets shown seem to add positive amounts (credits) but final invoice shows net +$12.3k because usage_charges were billed at on-demand rate before offsets reconciled. If credits are applied post-invoice we may get a refund but cashflow impact this month.
Dave: Quick estimate (very rough):
- duplicate reservation offset rows: $8,500 credited then recharged -> net +$8.5k
- wrong-region on-demand spike from test cluster (Mar12-15): $3,200
- currency rounding / meter-rate change adjustments: $600
Total: ~$12,300
Maria: Actionable items:
- Alex: confirm reservation -> billing account mapping and produce a list of affected projects by EOD (owner: Alex).
- SRE-Oncall: fix tagging rule and backfill corrected resource labels where possible (owner: SRE-Oncall).
- Dave: follow up with provider ticket daily and request provisional refund/credit (owner: Dave).
- Zoe: I'll earmark the $12k as investigation variance for this month and coordinate with AR if credit posts (owner: Zoe).
Zoe: Also, let's add a recurring check: every bill export run a simple SQL join that flags reservation_id used outside reservation.region. If any lines show region mismatch, auto-alert finance+infra.
Alex: I'll add that check to the billing pipeline tomorrow and add a threshold alert.
Dave: Provider replied initial ack, ETA 3 business days. CASE-2026-3872 status: acknowledged.
Zoe: Thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth. Will review attribution and whether to adjust reserved capacity strategy if this is a recurring pattern. :white_check_mark:
